# Sovrium SEO and GEO options

> Generated from the Sovrium schema by scripts/build/generate-skill-references.ts — do not edit. It carries no version on purpose: when it and the binary you run disagree, the binary is right.

Every option that decides how a Sovrium app is found — page metadata, sitemaps, feeds, content directories, `llms.txt`, languages and redirects — with the command that prints its full entry (kind, allowed values, default, guidance) from the binary you run.

## `pages[].sitemap`

| Option | Kind | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].sitemap` | enum \| object | Per-page sitemap configuration, or false to exclude from sitemap |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].sitemap.priority` | number | Sitemap priority (0.0 to 1.0, default: 0.5) |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].sitemap.changefreq` | enum | Hint to search engines about how often the page content changes |

## `pages[].contentDir`

| Option | Kind | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir` | object | Collection configuration that generates one route per markdown file in a directory |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.directory` | string | Directory containing markdown content files |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.slugFrom` | enum | Derive URL slug from filename (blog-post.md → blog-post) or filepath |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.index` | string | Slug of the index article served at the collection base path (page path minus its trailing dynamic segment). The slugged URL 301-redirects to the base path. E.g. "introduction". |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.include` | string | Glob pattern to filter files (e.g., *.md) |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.sort` | object | Sort configuration for content directory collection pages |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.sort.field` | string | Frontmatter field to sort by (e.g., date) |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.sort.order` | enum | Sort order (default: desc) |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.sort.direction` | enum | Sort direction (alias for order) |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.filter` | object | Filter conditions for content files (e.g., by frontmatter) |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.nav` | object | Sidebar navigation configuration derived from a content directory collection |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.nav.enabled` | boolean | Enable a docs sidebar derived from the collection files |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.nav.groupBy` | string | Frontmatter field used to group sidebar entries (e.g., category) |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.nav.labelFrom` | string | Frontmatter field used as the sidebar link label (e.g., title) |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.nav.groupLabels` | object | Map of raw groupBy keys to display labels (e.g., { Guides: "Developer Guides" }) |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.nav.groupIcons` | object | Map of raw groupBy keys to Lucide icon names (kebab-case, e.g. { tables: "compass" }) |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.nav.collapsed` | boolean | Collapse sidebar group sections by default, expanding only the active group (default: false) |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.nav.tabs` | array | Docs navigation tabs (zones) in tab-strip order. Each owns a disjoint set of sidebar sections. |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.nav.tabs[]` | object | One docs navigation tab (zone) owning a set of sidebar sections |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.nav.tabs[].id` | string | Stable tab identifier, announced as data-docs-active-zone on the docs sidebar (e.g. "tables") |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.nav.tabs[].label` | string | Tab display label, also the breadcrumb root-crumb name. Already-localised per locale. Absent = humanized id. |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.nav.tabs[].href` | string | Tab landing URL used as the breadcrumb root href. Absent = derived from the tab's first sidebar entry (self-healing). |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.nav.tabs[].sections` | array | Section slugs owned by this tab, in sidebar group order within the tab (orthogonal to contentDir.sort, which orders entries inside each group) |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.nav.tabs[].sections[]` | string | A groupBy section slug owned by this tab |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.editUrl` | string | Edit-this-page URL template for docs articles. Placeholders: {slug} (resolved article slug), {path} (source file path relative to directory, = {slug}.md), {lang} (active request language, empty when no /:lang/ prefix). Absent = no edit link (opt-in, default off). E.g. https://github.com/acme/repo/edit/main/docs/{lang}/{slug}.md |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.issueUrl` | string | Report-an-issue URL template for docs articles. Same placeholders as editUrl ({slug}, {path}, {lang}) but OPTIONAL — a bare issue-tracker URL with no placeholder is valid (passes through verbatim). Absent = no issue link (opt-in, default off). E.g. https://github.com/acme/repo/issues/new |
| `sovrium docs config pages[].contentDir.contributionNote` | string | Per-locale contribution note rendered (raw string) in the docs article contribution footer, beside the edit/issue links. Not interpolated. Absent = no note (opt-in, default off). |

## `llms`

| Option | Kind | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sovrium docs config llms` | object | Configuration for the auto-generated /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt routes (llmstxt.org). |
| `sovrium docs config llms.enabled` | boolean | Enable the auto-generated /llms.txt routes (default: true when docs exist) |
| `sovrium docs config llms.title` | string | Override the H1 title at the top of /llms.txt |
| `sovrium docs config llms.description` | string | Override the blockquote description in /llms.txt |
| `sovrium docs config llms.full` | boolean | Serve /llms-full.txt with concatenated bodies |

## `languages`

| Option | Kind | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sovrium docs config languages` | object | Multi-language support configuration for the entire application |
| `sovrium docs config languages.default` | string | Short language code (2 letters) for URLs and routing |
| `sovrium docs config languages.supported` | array | List of supported languages |
| `sovrium docs config languages.supported[]` | object | Configuration for a single supported language |
| `sovrium docs config languages.supported[].code` | string | Short language code used for URLs and routing (ISO 639-1, 2 letters) |
| `sovrium docs config languages.supported[].locale` | string | Full locale code used for HTML lang attribute and locale-specific formatting |
| `sovrium docs config languages.supported[].label` | string | Human-readable language name |
| `sovrium docs config languages.supported[].direction` | enum | Text direction (left-to-right or right-to-left) |
| `sovrium docs config languages.supported[].flag` | string | Flag emoji or icon path |
| `sovrium docs config languages.fallback` | string | Short language code (2 letters) for URLs and routing |
| `sovrium docs config languages.detectBrowser` | boolean | Picks the language from the reader's browser on a first visit, when the address itself does not name one. |
| `sovrium docs config languages.persistSelection` | boolean | Remember the reader’s language choice (default: true). Remembered in BOTH halves at once: the browser, and the `sovrium_language` cookie the SERVER reads — so the next document is composed in the chosen language rather than repainted after it arrives. `false` disables both sides: the switcher writes nothing, and a cookie or account preference that arrives anyway is ignored. It never disables the language feature itself — a `/{lang}/` address still works. |
| `sovrium docs config languages.translations` | object | Translation dictionaries for all supported languages (keyed by short codes: en, fr, es). Use $t:key syntax to reference translations. |

## `redirects[]`

| Option | Kind | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sovrium docs config redirects[]` | object | A single URL redirect: the retired path, its replacement, and the HTTP status to answer with. |
| `sovrium docs config redirects[].from` | string | Root-relative path to redirect FROM (e.g. '/products/platform'). Matched locale-agnostically unless it already begins with a configured language segment. |
| `sovrium docs config redirects[].to` | string | Redirect target — a root-relative path (e.g. '/') or an absolute http(s) URL. A path target inherits the request's language prefix; an absolute URL is used verbatim. |
| `sovrium docs config redirects[].status` | enum | HTTP redirect status code. Defaults to 301 (Moved Permanently) when omitted. |
| `sovrium docs config redirects[].localizeTarget` | boolean | Whether a root-relative target inherits the language prefix matched by 'from' (default: true). Set false when the target lives outside the locale namespace (e.g. '/_admin/login'), so it is emitted verbatim. |
